title: orders.job-rescheduled.v1
description: A garment's promised date moved. previousDueDate is the field this event exists for: Reporting #45 measures promised-against-actual turnaround, which is meaningless without knowing which promise moved. Only the garment's date moves — the command does not touch the order's own promised date, so a consumer must not infer one from this event. The reason is mandatory to the command and withheld from the payload: renegotiating a promise honestly means saying why, and the free text saying why is what a member of staff typed about a named person's garment. No actor either — audit (ARCH-008) is the authority on who.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the rescheduling was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The garment job, ordered behind its orders.garment-job-created.v1.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch whose workshop is making it.

orderId.description: The order the garment belongs to.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, so a rack tag can be named.

dueDate.description: The new promised date. A branch-local date, already evaluated in the branch timezone against the branch working calendar by the caller (docs/architecture/conventions.md section 2.2).

previousDueDate.description: The promise that was replaced, branch-local on the same terms. The due date is the one fact the domain overwrites in place, so a projection that missed an earlier message cannot reconstruct it — which is why it is published, and why the caller reads it before the transition rather than after.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
